text:
jorge: hey support — we started getting 400s on tool calls to our 'webhook' tool. Error: "invalid_tool_args: expected object, got string". This started right after upgrading the python SDK to 0.9.2. minimal repro below.

jorge: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
resp = client.responses.create(
    model='rwd-llm-1',
    input='call webhook',
    tools=[{'name':'webhook', 'schema':{'type':'object','properties':{'request':{'type':'object'}}}}],
    tool_call={'name':'webhook','arguments':{'request':{'user_id': 42}}}
)
print(resp.status_code, resp.json())
```

jorge: server trace shows body arriving as: "\"tool_call\": { \"name\": \"webhook\", \"arguments\": \"{\\\"request\\\":{\\\"user_id\\\":42}}\" }" (arguments is a JSON-string, not an object)

sophie: thanks — can you also paste the exact HTTP JSON that the SDK sent (curl -v / print request body)? and does TS/Go client do the same? is this just webhook tool or any tool? :eyes:

jorge: pasted curl log: ```
POST /v1/responses HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rwd-llm-1",
  "input": "call webhook",
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "webhook",
    "arguments": "{\\\"request\\\":{\\\"user_id\\\":42}}"
  }
}
```

jorge: TS client example (works): ```ts
const r = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW });
await r.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-llm-1', input: 'call webhook', tool_call: { name: 'webhook', arguments: { request: { user_id: 42 } } } });
```

mike: looking. initial hunch: py SDK 0.9.2 has a regression where args are being json.dumps'ed before attaching to the JSON payload when a dict is passed (we added a compatibility path for bytes/UUIDs and accidentally stringified everything).

jorge: confirmed with tcpdump — the wire shows a string for arguments. Tools fail schema validation and the LLM falls back to non-tool generation, so customer-facing QoS hit.

aj: repro'd locally. 0.9.2 introduced _encode_tool_args that does: `json.dumps(args)` and then assigns that string to the outgoing envelope. This breaks the tool schema check on service side (we expect a JSON object). PR fix is merged and will be in 0.9.3. Quick workaround: downgrade to 0.9.1 or construct the HTTP body yourself and call client._raw_post(...). Example workaround:```python
# workaround: build request body and call raw endpoint
body = { 'model':'rwd-llm-1','input':'call webhook','tool_call':{'name':'webhook','arguments':{'request':{'user_id':42}}} }
client._raw_post('/v1/responses', json=body)
```

aj: we'll publish 0.9.3 with the fix today, includes regression test that asserts arguments are typed as object on the wire.

jorge: great, thanks. will downgrade for now and try 0.9.3 when released. any ETA?

ci-bot: released redwood-python 0.9.3 -> main (cherry-pick fix for tool args marshalling) :shipit:

mike: followup note: the root cause was trying to special-case bytes and UUID by pre-serializing them into strings; we now only pre-serialize those specific types and keep dict/list as native JSON structures. also added server-side validation error to suggest "arguments should be JSON object" with example.

jorge: verified 0.9.3 fixed it for our app. thanks all :raised_hands:
